items.question: In the UAE, which federal law number from 2006 concerns the rights of people with special needs (people of determination)?
items.fact: Federal Law No. 29 of 2006 protects rights of people with special needs

items.question: In the UAE, which government ministry issues the People of Determination Card?
items.gold: The Ministry of Family issues the People of Determination Card.
items.fact: Ministry of Family issues the People of Determination Card to persons with disabilities
